id.description: Identifier of the invitation record. Absent for a referral. The connection the invitation produces carries this value as `invitationId`.

invitation.description: The Out-of-Band invitation, in the envelope that `didcommVersion` selects. Present for a standalone invitation only.

shortUrl.description: A URL under PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL that resolves to the same invitation, for a QR code. Present for a standalone invitation only.

messageId.description: Identifier of the sent message: the Out-of-Band 1.1 invitation on a v1 connection, the share-media message that carries the Out-of-Band 2.0 invitation on a v2 connection. Present when `connectionId` is present.

400.description: The body fails validation, `did` comes without `connectionId`, or `reusable` with it

404.description: No connection with the given id
